notes: «أخبرني من، شهد النبي» gives an unnamed transmitter (من) who witnessed the scene; the clause after the comma describes him and is not a name
after the saying, «قلت من حدثك قال ابن عباس» names Ibn Abbas as the source of that unnamed link; it is a second chain written after the saying, so it is not a route here (rule 9)
the Prophet is not a link; «رضى الله عنهما» is a blessing
